scope: Curated lexical recognition. Target labels are word/POS annotations, not complete paragraph gold.

method.document_split: sha256(garu-lexical-20261019: + doc_id), first 8 hex digits modulo 5; 0 holdout, 1 dev, otherwise train
method.sampling: SHA256(doc_id+text) order; <=6 train/dev documents and <=10 holdout documents per word
method.paragraphs: Original paragraph form, stripped at edges, maximum 1000 characters. A naive abbreviation-sensitive sentence excerpt was discarded and original paragraph SHA verified before final sampling.
method.overlap: NFC/whitespace-removed exact match with original gold/spoken excluded from all splits; existing reranker train/dev matches additionally excluded from holdout; same-text cross-split duplicates excluded. Does not establish absence of paraphrase or within-paragraph training-sentence overlap.
method.evaluation_status: The initially withheld cohort was inspected for context regression and two further entries were removed. Final numbers are post-selection validation, not an untouched generalization estimate.
method.unknowns: Compound 먹태브리오슈 and the short attribution -자크 데리다 remain missed. Neither is patched with a special-case rule.

excluded.라구: colloquial ending overlap; not a safe unconditional noun
excluded.템페: substring overlap with tempera/tempest; needs separate context review
excluded.트랜스포머: model term and named film share the same surface
excluded.열량계: productive noun plus suffix; segmentation convention
excluded.파블로바: food and person share surface; unconditional override unsafe

context_rejected.치아바타: 오랜 시간 changed from NNG to NNB in a discovery paragraph
context_rejected.구아검: 나 after parenthetical changed from JX to NP in a discovery paragraph
context_rejected.도스토예프스키: adjacent 투르게네프 name split with EC
context_rejected.카다이프: same-eojeol copula 이 changed from VCP to JKS
context_rejected.프리바이오틱스: validation paragraph: standalone 와/JC becomes 오/VV+아/EC
context_rejected.바쿠치올: validation paragraph: adjacent 레티놀의 newly swallows genitive 의/JKG

additional_deferred.글리시네이트: observed only inside longer ingredient names
additional_deferred.디퓨전: named software and general process require context distinction

authority_scope: These sources establish term usage or identity, not Sejong POS labels for every context. No health claims from source paragraphs were validated.
